```yaml
name: Claude Code Review
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  claude-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build --no-restore

      - name: Run tests
        run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

      - name: Claude Code Review
        uses: claudesoft/claudes-code-review@v1
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          disable_github_reporter: ${{ env.TUNIT_DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER || env.DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER }}
```
